svg.title: Bastionfall original illustrated 3D cartoon visual target
svg.desc: A whimsical sculpted fantasy tower-defense scene with strong cel-shaped forms, blue-roofed keep, copper bolt towers, red raiders and a gold-blue hero, with a graphic style guide at right. Concept reference, not current gameplay.
svg.text: Independent Bastionfall vector composition study • the runtime must be judged by real screenshot evidence.
